authority: Explicit owner instruction in the project chat

decision.implementation: Codex performs tasks directly in the owner conversation
decision.multica: Remove execution automation and supporting worker infrastructure; optional board and task storage only
decision.final_testing: The owner performs final testing and acceptance
decision.review_routing: No mandatory worker or independent reviewer pipeline; extra reviewers only on owner request

supersedes: Mandatory Multica dispatch and live-state authority
Executor/controller/reviewer routing in prior policies and task documents
Mandatory runtime briefs, checkpoints, capability profiles and native usage gates
preserve: Owner edits, source assets, task history and exact evidence
Focused technical self-checks and local task-scoped commits
Existing separate asset registry and shared PostgreSQL data
does_not_authorize: Execution of prepared backlog tasks or acceptance of gameplay/art changes
